summary: Ponton lookout in Alberta: a 30 m steel tower that the provincial record dates to 2014 and lists as active. No history found.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, 30 m (98 ft) tall, per the provincial record

access.note: The provincial record gives the access mode as fly and marks the tower active. A regional archive says the public may no longer climb Alberta lookout towers. No source read says the site is open to visitors.

events.note: Provincial record: year constructed 2014 for the steel tower listed at Ponton. No source read describes an earlier lookout on the site.

evidence.supports: Alberta has 127 wildfire lookout sites spread through the boreal forest and along the Rocky Mountains
evidence.quote: Map showing the locations of Alberta's 127 wildfire lookout sites

evidence.supports: the lookout sites are situated throughout the boreal forest and along the Rocky Mountains
evidence.quote: which are situated throughout the province's boreal forest and along the Rocky Mountains

evidence.supports: lookouts are an integral part of wildfire detection and sit where visibility is favourable
evidence.quote: Fire lookouts are an integral component of wildfire detection in Alberta and are located where visibility is favourable to detect and report wildfires.

evidence.supports: Ponton is a steel wildfire lookout built in 2014
the tower is 30 m tall and the site is at 954 m elevation
the location is verified, the tower is active, and the access mode is fly
the tower has a weather station
the public is no longer permitted to climb the towers
evidence.quote: it is no longer permitted for the public to climb these towers

corrections.why: No source read says the site is closed. The record marks the tower active with access mode fly, and the archive says the public may not climb the towers. Restricted fits the sources better than closed.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta, layer records for Puskwaskau, Ponton and Rainbow

notes_for_editor: The only source for this tower is the provincial layer record: build year, height, elevation, active flag and access mode. Two searches (Ponton fire lookout; Ponton fire tower Peace River region) returned nothing about the tower's history, staffing or fires, and the 2008-2009 lookout directories did not load. The regional archive quote is about all Alberta lookout towers, not this site. The layer metadata classifies the dataset as Protected, so only single attribute values are quoted. The brief's access value 'closed' is not supported; see the correction.
